Workshop 7 - Housing in Developing Urban Areas:
The Respective Roles of the Private and Public Housing Sectors

Thursday, November 19, 2026 | 8:30 AM - 1:00 PM

World Bank (MC C2-350) and Online

In-Person Registration

Virtual Registration

The WBG – GWU Livable and Sustainable Cities workshop series brings together academics and development practitioners to present and discuss questions relating to Sustainable Urbanization. Each workshop in the series focuses on a particular topic relating to cities in developing countries.

The workshops are hosted by the World Bank (Urban, Subnational Finance, Tourism and Disaster Management Global Department) and George Washington University (Institute for International Economic Policy; Department of Economics).
